property_summary: For any caller and any block timestamp, if a call to the fallback is made with msg.value == 10 ether the reference contract accepts (does not revert) and updates pastBlockTime to block.timestamp; the mutant that requires 5 ether will reject 10 ether calls, causing the property to fail for some fuzzed msg.value (e.g., 10 ether).
change_summary: Change the required incoming ETH amount from 10 ether to 5 ether, altering when the fallback accepts and updates state.
